# Studio Browne

> Full-service interior design studio led by principal Matt Browne. Warm, modern homes made from natural materials and real craftsmanship, for clients in Beverly Hills, Los Angeles and San Francisco. 10+ years practicing in SF & LA. Interior Architecture, UCLA & SMC.

Studio Browne designs residential interiors from first sketch to final install: concept, floor plans, finishes, furniture, lighting, custom millwork, contractors and styling. Much of the San Francisco work is in historic houses, where the studio keeps original architecture and craftsmanship and modernizes the rest. Photorealistic renderings let clients see rooms before anything is built.

Contact: matt@studio-browne.com · 310.486.2867 · Beverly Hills, CA

## Services

- Full-service interior design
- Residential remodels: kitchens, baths and whole houses
- Historic home restoration
- Lighting design and bespoke fixtures
- Custom millwork and built-ins
- Furniture, art and antiques sourcing
- Photorealistic renderings

## Projects

- [Vallejo](https://www.studio-browne.com/vallejo.html): Albert L. Farr shingled Arts & Crafts house above Cow Hollow, Pacific Heights, San Francisco (2020). Architect Albert L. Farr & Studio 12 Architecture; construction Thomas Building Group; bespoke lighting by Daniel Hopper.
- [Jackson](https://www.studio-browne.com/jackson.html): 1895 Pacific Heights house by William H. Lillie; interior design and partial remodel (2018).
- [Broadway](https://www.studio-browne.com/broadway.html): Pacific Heights house with a custom steel ribbon chandelier, hanging leather daybed and ring light (2019).
- [Filbert](https://www.studio-browne.com/filbert.html): 1914 Russian Hill flat; full-service design including an attic bedroom (2018).
- [Robertson](https://www.studio-browne.com/robertson.html): Beverly Hills residence, conceptual design, in progress.
- [San José del Cabo](https://www.studio-browne.com/project.html): house in Baja California Sur, Mexico, in design.
